motion.name: script-playback
motion.value: elapsed-time based, 60 Hz timer while playing
motion.purpose: User-controlled script motion; timer stops when paused or hidden.

narrative.overview: A reading instrument, not a presentation surface. Follow the user's Notchprompt reference: a compact black reading strip paired with a conventional native macOS workspace.
dos: Do keep reading text above controls and nearest the camera.
Do preserve native focus, selection, keyboard, and appearance behavior.
Do make position a user choice and provide physical-top snapping.
donts: Don't center the overlay on the notch or add a title bar above the script.
Don't imply that floating-window content is hidden from screen recordings.
